Perfect! I can see the issue clearly. The job is being terminated by a SIGTERM signal at the activeDeadlineSeconds (3600 seconds = 1 hour). The logs show the job is making progress but is slow - it takes about 8-9 minutes per batch to complete. At that rate, 95 batches would take much longer than the 1-hour deadline.

The errors about SMTP connection refused are also present but those are non-fatal - the job continues processing. The real issue is that the activeDeadlineSeconds is too short for the amount of work.

Let me search the documentation for information about activeDeadlineSeconds to provide proper guidance.
